title: Ask Pilot AI
sub: Ask about your ads in your own words. Pilot AI reads your numbers at Meta and answers. It changes nothing without your “Yes, do it”.
start: Try one of these questions, or write your own:
ph: E.g.: which ad costs me the most?
thinking: Pilot AI is reading your ads at Meta…
waiting: Nothing has changed at Meta yet.
demo: Demo: Pilot AI answers with the demo’s numbers, nothing goes to Meta.
demoAi: Demo: Pilot AI reads the demo’s ads, nothing goes to Meta.
noAi: Pilot AI is not ready for this shop yet.
notLinked: Link the Meta ad account (Pilot AI › Accounts): Pilot AI reads your ads at Meta.

tries.a: Which ad costs me the most per purchase?
tries.b: Compare this week with last week
tries.c: How much did I spend these 7 days?
tries.d: Pause the one that sells the least
tries.e: Raise the best one a little
